events.headline: Morocco denies involvement in migrant surge into Spain’s Ceuta

members.title: Morocco denies involvement in migrant surge into Spain’s Ceuta
members.snippet: Over 70,000 migrants entered Ceuta, sparking a humanitarian crisis and political tensions between Spain and Morocco.
